options.content:
Simulated research only. About eight minutes of capture. No realized results.

Each experiment has its own quote asset and overlapping candidate scope. ModelRanking is ranking-v0 heuristic; no learned model was involved.

targets.rawSql: SELECT result_id AS "Experiment", evidence_kind AS "Evidence kind", status AS "Status", scope_label AS "Scope", scope->'routeShapes' AS "Route shapes", scope->>'poolCount' AS "Pool count", quote_symbol AS "Quote asset", window_start_utc AS "Window start UTC", window_end_utc AS "Window end UTC" FROM research.experiments ORDER BY result_id

panels.title: Coverage: evaluable share per experiment and policy

targets.rawSql: SELECT result_id || ' / ' || policy_kind AS metric, evaluable_share_pct AS value FROM research.v_policy_evidence ORDER BY result_id, policy_kind

SELECT result_id AS "Experiment", policy_kind AS "Policy", evaluable_candidates AS "Evaluable", candidates_evaluated AS "Evaluated", unevaluable_candidates AS "Unevaluable", evaluable_share_pct AS "Share percent" FROM research.v_policy_evidence ORDER BY result_id, policy_kind

panels.title: Where candidates went: rejection counts
panels.description: One selected experiment. Rejection counts are grouped by policy and reason.

targets.rawSql: SELECT policy_kind AS policy, max(rejected_count) FILTER (WHERE reason_code='below_threshold') AS below_threshold, max(rejected_count) FILTER (WHERE reason_code='insufficient_state') AS insufficient_state, max(rejected_count) FILTER (WHERE reason_code='tick_array_absent') AS tick_array_absent, max(rejected_count) FILTER (WHERE reason_code='state_gap') AS state_gap FROM research.policy_rejections WHERE result_id=${experiment:sqlstring} GROUP BY policy_kind ORDER BY policy_kind

SELECT policy_kind AS "Policy", opportunities_detected AS "Detected", selected_or_executed AS "Selected or executed", CASE WHEN estimated_net_profit_quote IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE estimated_net_profit_quote::text || ' ' || quote_symbol END AS "Estimated net profit", CASE WHEN simulated_net_profit_quote IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE simulated_net_profit_quote::text || ' ' || quote_symbol END AS "Simulated net profit", missed_candidates AS "Missed", CASE WHEN realized_net_profit_quote IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE realized_net_profit_quote::text || ' ' || quote_symbol END AS "Realized net profit" FROM research.v_policy_evidence WHERE result_id=${experiment:sqlstring} ORDER BY policy_kind

panels.title: Shape coverage: triangle and two-leg within selected universe

targets.rawSql: SELECT shape AS "Shape", route_count AS "Routes", policy_kind AS "Policy", evaluable_candidates AS "Evaluable", candidates_evaluated AS "Evaluated", unevaluable_candidates AS "Unevaluable", evaluable_share_pct AS "Share percent", CASE WHEN estimated_net_profit_quote IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE estimated_net_profit_quote::text || ' ' || quote_symbol END AS "Estimated net profit", CASE WHEN simulated_net_profit_quote IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE simulated_net_profit_quote::text || ' ' || quote_symbol END AS "Simulated net profit" FROM research.v_shape_evidence WHERE result_id=${experiment:sqlstring} ORDER BY shape, policy_kind

panels.title: Missing state by pool — Diagnostic probe: raw input amounts, not chained route amounts
panels.description: Diagnostic probe at raw input atoms. These values are not chained route amounts.

targets.rawSql: SELECT seed_loaded_at AS time, pool_id || ' / ' || input_token || ' → ' || output_token || ' / ' || outcome AS metric, outcome_count AS value FROM research.v_probe_evidence WHERE result_id=${experiment:sqlstring} AND outcome IN ('state_gap','insufficient_state','tick_array_absent') ORDER BY pool_id, input_token, outcome

list.name: experiment
list.label: Experiment
list.query: SELECT result_id AS __text, result_id AS __value FROM research.experiments ORDER BY result_id
